localChanges: In Civilization games, Settlers can now build a Fortress once Construction is known (press F). A land unit defending on one has its defence doubled, in place of being fortified, and when it loses, only it dies rather than every unit with it. Founding a city on the square takes the Fortress away (closes #388).
The map now draws Fortresses with Civilization's art, and Farmland, Fortresses and Airbases with Civilization II's. With civ.one's own pixel art they aren't drawn yet (#1243).

log: For civ-clone/web-renderer#388: a city founded on a Fortress takes it away, and one finished on a city's square is taken away.
For civ-clone/web-renderer#388. Also fixes RailroadTo through a city's test for base-unit-action-build-railroad's newer releases, which finish a Railroad with the action's registry.
